target.title: fix(telegram): keep over-limit-name models selectable in /model picker (#98221)
target.body:
Fixes #98221

## What Problem This Solves

The Telegram `/model` picker silently omits any model whose `callback_data` exceeds Telegram's 64-byte limit on both the standard (`mdl_sel_{provider}/{model}`) and compact (`mdl_sel/{model}`) encodings. The header reports the correct total (for example, "7 available") but fewer buttons render, with no error, warning, or placeholder. Long namespaced Ollama ids, increasingly common with community fine-tunes, become unreachable from the picker.

## Why This Change Was Made

`buildModelSelectionCallbackData` embeds the full model name in the callback, so an arbitrarily long name cannot fit 64 bytes and `buildModelsKeyboard` dropped it (`if (!callbackData) continue`). The 64-byte ceiling is a hard Telegram limit, so this adds a length-safe provider/index callback resolved server-side against the same sorted list the keyboard was built from.

The latest follow-up also binds index callbacks to a compact model identity token. If the provider model list changes while an old keyboard is visible and the old index now points at a different model, the handler now asks the user to rerun `/model` instead of applying the wrong model.

## User Impact

- Long-named models are no longer dropped; every model in the reported count is selectable.
- Short names keep their existing readable name-based callbacks.
- Over-limit models render length-safe index callbacks (`mdl_idx_{provider}_{index}_{token}`).
- Stale in-range index callbacks refresh instead of selecting a different current model.

## Evidence

Local macOS validation against head `1f829039bc`:

- `extensions/telegram/src/model-buttons.ts`: index callbacks now include a compact identity token; `resolveIndexedModelSelection` rejects missing or token-mismatched indexes.
- `extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.ts`: the callback handler resolves `selectIndex` through `resolveIndexedModelSelection`; missing or mismatched identity prompts `That model list changed. Send /model again to refresh.`
- `extensions/telegram/src/model-buttons.test.ts`: added regression coverage for stale in-range index drift and token-bound over-limit callbacks.
- RED/GREEN: the stale-index regression failed before the helper existed, then passed after the token guard.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/telegram/src/model-buttons.test.ts` — 29 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/telegram/src/model-buttons.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot.create-telegram-bot.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot.test.ts` — 224 tests passed.
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions` and `pnpm tsgo:extensions:test` — passed.
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs extensions/telegram/src/model-buttons.ts extensions/telegram/src/model-buttons.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.ts` — passed.
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/telegram/src/model-buttons.ts extensions/telegram/src/model-buttons.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.ts` — passed.
- `git diff --check` and `node scripts/check-no-conflict-markers.mjs` — passed.
- `gitleaks protect --staged --redact` — no leaks.

## Real Behavior Proof

Mantis captured native Telegram Desktop before/after proof in PR comment `openclaw-mantis` on 2026-06-30:

- Workflow run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28465647047
- Artifact: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28465647047/artifacts/7990537958
- Baseline screenshot: https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/mantis/telegram-desktop/pr-98230/run-28465647047-1/baseline/telegram-desktop-proof.png
- Candidate screenshot: https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/mantis/telegram-desktop/pr-98230/run-28465647047-1/candidate/telegram-desktop-proof.png
- Baseline GIF: https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/mantis/telegram-desktop/pr-98230/run-28465647047-1/baseline/telegram-desktop-proof.gif
- Candidate GIF: https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/mantis/telegram-desktop/pr-98230/run-28465647047-1/candidate/telegram-desktop-proof.gif
- Raw QA index: https://artifacts.openclaw.ai/mantis/telegram-desktop/pr-98230/run-28465647047-1/index.json

Summary from the proof: current `main` reports 2 available models but shows only one listed model; this PR shows the long over-limit model button in native Telegram Desktop.
